source: GROUND.md §6.9. Rust's animals are the target. From the Facepunch Rust wiki (read 13 October 2026): health (wolf 100; deer and boar 150, as Rust's stag and pig; bear 400) and what a corpse gives (deer 4 meat, 50 leather, 50 bone fragments, 10 fat; pig 8 pork, 20 leather, 50 bone fragments, 40 fat; wolf 5 meat, 75 leather, 40 bone fragments, 10 fat; bear 20 meat, 100 leather, 150 bone fragments, 100 fat; their cloth is left out, hide stands for leather). Population in animals a square kilometre of land that suits them, from Rust's server settings (stag 3, boar 5, wolf 2, bear 2) raised for a zone a few kilometres across (Rust's maps are bigger and its animals roam): deer 12, boars 8, wolves 4, and the bear, the rare apex, 1.2; a player usually has a herd or two within reach (GROUND.md §11 N3). Speeds, senses, bites and charges are ours (the wiki has none), set against the player's 5.5 m/s sprint and 100 health: a deer outruns everything, wolves and bears outrun a sprinting player, a boar nearly does. Names are plain words.

senses.note: How far noises carry, in metres, before a species' hearing; a crouching player is seen at 55% of the range, one standing still at 80%; anything within 5 m is noticed whichever way an animal faces.

spawning.note: Spawn areas of 256 m: out while a player is within 380 m, gone 30 s after the last left beyond 560 m. Animals appear at least 70 m from every player.

harvest.note: Harvest health a hit takes from a corpse: the bone knife is the butcher's tool (Rust's), hatchets and the machete are good, a rock is poor; other melee items take 40% of their damage. As with gathering, a better tool is quicker, not richer (GROUND.md §6.1).

species.name: Deer
species.note: A grazer in herds: it watches what it notices, runs from people within 30 m, from gunshots and from wolves and bears, and the whole herd runs with it. It never fights.

species.name: Boar
species.note: Roots about alone or in twos and threes and leaves people be, but snorts at anyone closer than 4.5 m and charges them, and charges whoever hurts it for up to 9 s and 45 m. Gunfire sends it off; badly hurt it runs.

species.name: Wolf
species.note: Hunts in packs of two to four when hungry (hunger fills in about four minutes): people it notices, deer and boars. It stalks at a trot from afar, runs in close, bites two at a time while the rest circle. Fed, it growls at anyone within 7 m before it bites. Badly hurt it runs; it gives up a chase after 25 s without getting close, or 160 m from where it began.

species.name: Bear
species.note: The rare apex: alone, slow to anger but deadly. Anyone within 15 m gets a warning (it rears and roars), then a charge; it turns on whoever hurts it; it hunts only when very hungry. Its swipes land a body blow that armour on the chest softens. It gives up after 15 s or 70 m.
